title: Codebase ingestion maps code with the language's own tools
goal: An agent ingesting a repository, or using the kb as a plugin in a host project, gets the repository's toolchain pins and a map of its packages, imports and symbols from deterministic tools at a pinned commit: kbingest.py survey reports the pins, an operator-approved read-only mapping mode records tool-native maps, topics_for can match code by its imports, /kb-ingest and the plugin docs use them, and the research gaps left by the codebase-mapping topics are worked.
notes: Operator scope (2026-09-28 planning): pins are parsed with the standard library and never execute repository code; running installed toolchains waits on the gate of ST-55lva2xl; topics_for keeps its lexical default and adds an import-aware mode; the research gaps are one story. Out of scope: new dependencies (tools stay stdlib only), a semantic or embeddings index, changing signals.csv's format.
